SELECT curriculum.curriculum_item_id, curriculum.main_chapter_id, chapter.title, chapter.chapter_type, curriculum.display_order, curriculum.source_type, curriculum.status, curriculum.completed_at, CASE WHEN curriculum.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 100 WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sub_chapters active_sub WHERE active_sub.main_chapter_id = curriculum.main_chapter_id AND active_sub.is_active = TRUE ) THEN 0 ELSE CAST(FLOOR( 100.0 * ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sub_chapters completed_sub INNER JOIN user_learning_progress progress ON progress.sub_chapter_id = completed_sub.sub_chapter_id AND progress.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND progress.status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE completed_sub.main_chapter_id = curriculum.main_chapter_id AND completed_sub.is_active = TRUE ) / ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sub_chapters active_sub WHERE active_sub.main_chapter_id = curriculum.main_chapter_id AND active_sub.is_active = TRUE ) ) AS SIGNED) END AS progress_percent FROM user_curriculum_items curriculum INNER JOIN main_chapters chapter ON chapter.main_chapter_id = curriculum.main_chapter_id WHERE curriculum.user_id = #{userId} AND curriculum.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY curriculum.display_order, curriculum.curriculum_item_id
